scripts.deploy:dev: vite build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=ssasaleshub
scripts.deploy:prod: vite build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=ssasaleshub --branch=main
scripts.cap:sync: vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.android:debug: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
